title: Genotyping the ADAMTS5-P Mouse Strain
author: Bianca Hemmeryckx
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kaucsew

steps.title: Prepare lysis buffer (1 L)
steps.instruction: Make 1 L of lysis buffer by mixing the following components:

substeps.instruction: Add 40 mL of 5 M NaCl (final 0.2 M).
Add 100 mL of 1 M Tris‑HCl, pH 8 (final 0.1 M).
Add 10 mL of 0.5 M EDTA (final 5 mM).
Mix thoroughly; the buffer is now ready.

steps.title: Prepare Proteinase K solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 100 mg Proteinase K (Merck MilliporeSigma, Catalog #3115879001) in 5 mL MilliQ water and 5 mL 100 % ethanol to obtain a 10 mg/mL solution.

steps.title: Collect ear tissue and lyse
steps.instruction: Cut a very small piece of mouse ear, place it in a labeled 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube containing 800 µL lysis buffer and add 8 µL of the 10 mg/mL Proteinase K solution.

steps.title: Overnight lysis incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes overnight at 55 °C.

steps.title: Vortex lysates
steps.instruction: Vortex each tube briefly to mix.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysates
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes for 10 min at 13 000 rpm at room temperature.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to isopropanol
steps.instruction: Transfer each supernatant to a new tube that already contains 600 µL isopropanol; complete the transfer for all samples.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA fibers
steps.instruction: Invert each tube gently, one at a time, until DNA fibers become visible.

steps.title: Collect DNA fibers
steps.instruction: Using a pipette tip (place a finger on the tip to keep liquid out), collect the visible DNA fibers.

steps.title: Prepare TE buffer (1 L)
steps.instruction: Make TE buffer by mixing:

steps.title: Rehydrate DNA in TE
steps.instruction: Transfer the DNA‑containing pipette tips into new labeled tubes with 200 µL TE buffer and incubate 15 min to allow rehydration.

steps.title: Final DNA incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes 1–2 h at 55 °C while vortexing to dissolve DNA; if genotyping will be delayed, store at –20 °C, otherwise continue.

steps.title: Prepare PCR reaction mix
steps.instruction: For each sample combine in a PCR tube:

substeps.instruction: Illustra PuReTaq Ready‑To‑Go PCR beads (GE Healthcare, Catalog #27-9557-02).
5 µL forward primer 5’‑TTT GAA TTT GTC TTT GGA AGG CCT C‑3’ (10 µM stock, 2 µM final).
5 µL reverse primer 5’‑TAT CCC CGG ATG AGT CAA CAC TGT C‑3’ (10 µM stock, 2 µM final).
Include a no‑DNA negative control and positive controls (WT, HE, KO) from previously genotyped animals.

steps.title: Load PCR plate into cycler
steps.instruction: Place the prepared PCR tubes in a 2720 Thermal Cycler (Applied Biosystems).

steps.title: Prepare 50× TAE stock (1 L)
steps.instruction: Mix:

substeps.instruction: Add MilliQ water to 800 mL, stir, then bring volume to 1 L with water.

steps.title: Make 1× TAE working solution
steps.instruction: Dilute 20 mL of the 50× TAE stock with 980 mL MilliQ water to obtain 1 L of 1× TAE (40 mM Tris, 20 mM acetic acid, 1 mM EDTA).

steps.title: Make 0.5× TAE with stain
steps.instruction: Dilute 10 mL of the 50× TAE stock with 990 mL MilliQ water to obtain 1 L of 0.5× TAE (20 mM Tris, 10 mM acetic acid, 0.5 mM EDTA) and add Midori Green Advanced DNA stain (5 µL per 100 mL). Use Molecular Biology Grade agarose (Catalog #EP-0010-05) and Midori Green stain (Catalog #NG MG04).

steps.title: Cast 2 % agarose gel
steps.instruction: Dissolve 2 g agarose in 100 mL 1× TAE, autoclave, pour into a gel tray with a comb, allow to solidify, then immerse the gel in the 0.5× TAE‑stain solution.

steps.title: Add loading dye to PCR products
steps.instruction: Mix 5 µL Orange DNA loading dye (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Catalog #R0631) with 25 µL of each PCR reaction.

steps.title: Load samples and ladder
steps.instruction: Load 18 µL of each dyed PCR sample and 18 µL of TriDye 100 bp DNA ladder (New England Biolabs, Catalog #N3271S) into the gel (up to 125 lanes).

steps.title: Run electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Run the gel for 30 min at 135 V using a Mupid‑One electrophoresis system (Eurogentec SA).

steps.title: Image gel
steps.instruction: Capture the gel image with a Bio‑Rad Molecular Imager Gel Doc XR+ and save the digital file.

steps.title: Interpret band patterns
steps.instruction: Identify genotypes based on band size: WT = single 650 bp band; KO = single 380 bp band; HE = both 650 bp and 380 bp bands.
